name: Gas Pipeline Branch and GRS KRP-21 (Chekhov district, Moscow Oblast)

values.PipelineName: Gas Pipeline Branch and GRS KRP-21

monitor_reason: length: only source for length is a single unattributed trade-site blurb (neftegazpro.ru, 2025-03-31) saying 'more than 100 km' and 220 thousand m3/h; the contractor page (gesrv.ru) gives 300 thousand m3/h and states no length, and decree 816-r app. 4 item 222 lists only 2.42 bcm/y and 'Chekhov urban okrug'. No sourced length >=25 km; a KRP (pressure-reduction station) with connecting branch near Peshkovo could well be short. Sponsor (Gazprom transgaz Moskva, customer Gazprom Invest / Gazprom rekonstruktsiya) and concrete step (construction March 2025 - Oct 2026) are met.
researcher_notes: Not matched to existing GEM rows (roster has only KGMO ring P2312/P2379/P2380 and long-haul to Moscow; none is KRP-21). Confirmed: gesrv.ru contractor page (construction Mar 2025-Oct 2026, Chekhov urban okrug near Peshkovo, stage I 300 thousand m3/h, customer Gazprom Invest branch Gazprom rekonstruktsiya, operator Gazprom transgaz Moskva); 816-r app. 4 #222 (Moscow Oblast, Chekhov, 2.42 bcm/y); interfax 2026-09 lists KRP-21 in 2026-2030 plan. '>100 km' appears on one marketing page and conflicts with the capacity on the contractor page; wording 'more than 100 km' for a KRP spur is implausible without corroboration. Re-vet if a length (project documentation, expertise conclusion, tender documentation) is found. Owner entity: entity_lookup returned only 'Transgaz' (not same entity); would need a new owner entity 'Gazprom transgaz Moskva' if ever staged. Evidence-only values, not stageable: Capacity not filled (220 vs 300 thousand m3/h conflict; 2.42 bcm/y from 816-r is a planned volume).
